npcs.name: 画画的人
npcs.role: a man painting the White Dagoba
npcs.character: Absorbed and gentle; happy to show his painting.
knows: The White Dagoba 白塔 was built for a Tibetan lama's visit, long ago

npcs.name: 打太极的阿姨
npcs.role: a woman doing 太极 on 景山 every morning
npcs.character: Calm, slow, kind; explains things with her hands.
knows: The old city wall stood where the second ring road is now
The palace wall has a tower on each corner
wants: Everyone to move a little every day

explains.城墙: 很长很高的墙，以前在北京老城的外面。
explains.西北角: 西边和北边的中间那儿。
explains.狐狸: 像小狗，红色或者白色的。

npcs.name: 唱歌的爷爷
npcs.role: an old man who sings on the top of 景山
npcs.character: Loud, jolly, sings old songs to the city below; saw the fox last night.
knows: A white fox was near the palace's north-west corner last night
From here you can see the whole palace

explains.故宫: 以前皇帝住的地方，很大。

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: That's the White Dagoba of 北海!
nodes.why: 北海 was an imperial garden; its White Dagoba 白塔 has stood on the island since 1651.

nodes.say: 你看，这是我画的白塔。好看吗？
nodes.translate: Look, this is my painting of the White Dagoba. Is it good?

nodes.say: 你好！上面很好看，你去看看吧！
nodes.translate: Hello! It's beautiful at the top — go and see!

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.why: From 景山 you see the whole Forbidden City, roof after golden roof, on Beijing's north–south axis.

nodes.translate: Look — the palace! Big, isn't it?

nodes.say: 我昨天晚上看见一只狐狸，在故宫西北角附近。
nodes.simpler: 我看见一只狐狸，在西北角。
nodes.translate: Last night I saw a fox, near the north-west corner of the palace.
nodes.why: A key line 📌: 西北 is north-west, 角 a corner, 附近 nearby. Ask the woman doing 太极 on the path — she explains them. The corner of the palace wall is by the corner tower, 角楼.

nodes.translate: Go and look for the fox tonight!
Hello! Beautiful up here, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: jiuweihu
nodes.say: 你是谁？你也怕我吧？老虎都怕我！
nodes.translate: Who are you? You're scared of me too, aren't you? Even tigers are scared of me!

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: That's 狐假虎威 — the fox borrowing the tiger's might.
nodes.why: A 成语 📌 with a story: the fox walked in front of the tiger, the animals fled from the tiger, and the fox said they feared *him*. Look it up in your 成语 book.

nodes.speaker: jiuweihu
nodes.say: 好吧……你知道我叫什么吗？
nodes.translate: Fine… do you know my name?
nodes.why: Say its name: 九尾狐 — 九 nine, 尾 tail, 狐 fox. Tones: jiǔ wěi hú.

nodes.speaker: jiuweihu
nodes.say: 对！我是九尾狐。我们是朋友了！
nodes.translate: Yes! I'm the nine-tailed fox. We're friends now!

words.explain: 很大的猫，很大很大，大家都怕它。

legend.zh: 《山海经》说，青丘山上有一只狐狸，它有九个尾巴。它的声音像小孩子。人们说，看见它，是好事。
legend.en: The Classic of Mountains and Seas says that on Mount Qingqiu lives a fox with nine tails, whose voice is like a child's. Seeing it, people said, was a good omen.

befriend.en: Say its name: 九尾狐, the nine-tailed fox.

idioms.meaning: to bully others with someone else's power — the fox borrowing the tiger's might

story.zh: 老虎要吃狐狸。狐狸说：“别吃我！动物们都怕我。你跟我走，你看看。”狐狸在前面走，老虎在后面走。动物们看见老虎，都跑了。老虎想：“它们真的怕狐狸！”
story.en: A tiger was about to eat a fox. The fox said: 'Don't! All the animals fear me. Walk behind me and see.' The fox walked in front, the tiger behind. The animals saw the tiger and fled — and the tiger thought: 'They really are afraid of the fox!'
